rationale: The agent covers the main build-heap guarantees, but its MAX-HEAPIFY correctness theorem needs a stronger precondition than the gold one and several gold MAX-HEAPIFY guarantees are missing or only partial. Covered: length preservation, permutation, the max-heap property everywhere after BUILD-MAX-HEAP (which implies the gold's all-subtrees, three-key and four-key heap results), the root being the maximum, parent/left inverse, left < right, and imperative/functional equivalence for heapify and build. MAX-HEAPIFY correctness assumes every higher index is already heap-ordered, while the gold assumes only that the two child subtrees are max-heaps, so the gold heapify_restores_heap theorem is not implied. Missing or partial: locality is only proved for indices below 2c+1 rather than for everything outside the subtree, the leaf, out-of-heap and already-largest no-op theorems are absent, as are sibling-subtree preservation, the three-node promotion facts, the pair-build theorem and the start-index facts.
